before-and-during-the-fremennik-trials.npc: Outlander, I have work to be getting on with... Please stop bothering me.

after-the-fremennik-trials-but-before-ol.npc: Good afternoon! How do you like our village?

after-the-fremennik-trials-but-before-ol.player: It's lovely. You have a fine collection of goats.

after-the-fremennik-trials-but-before-ol.npc: We polish them every day to get them nice and clean.

after-olaf-s-quest.npc: Hello again! Have you any word from my husband?

after-olaf-s-quest.player: Err, no, not yet. It takes a while for the messages to reach me, you know.

after-olaf-s-quest.npc: Well, when you do, tell him we'll be more than happy to see him again.
